content: Hi, I'm looking at Brightwater Algebra Live for my 15-year-old, who's failing Algebra II at 58% with the final in six weeks, and honestly I'm scared they're falling behind for good. I only have about 15 minutes before my shift, so could you tell me quickly what it covers and what it costs?

Hi there! I’m Maya. Brightwater Algebra Live gives your teen a 50‑minute one‑on‑one video session each week (or twice a week), focused on the exact Algebra II unit they’re studying and practice for upcoming tests—including the final in six weeks. Each session includes a written progress report for you. Sessions run M‑F 4‑10 pm MT (Sat 9 am‑5 pm) and the first session can be booked 14 days after signup.

**Plans**  
- **Essentials:** 4 sessions/month – $49 / mo (first month $39 if you enroll by Nov 29).  
- **Plus:** 8 sessions/month – $99 / mo (no promo).

If that sounds good, you can enroll now at **brightwaterlearning.example/enroll**. Let me know if you have any quick questions!
Honestly, I'm scared we've left it too late and they'll fail the final anyway. Does Brightwater Algebra Live actually work for a kid who is this far behind?

I hear how stressful this feels, and it’s great you’re looking for help right away. Our tutors focus each 50‑minute session on the exact Algebra II unit your child is on and on targeted practice for upcoming quizzes and the final. In a 2025 survey of 410 parents, 71 % said their child felt more confident in math after just two months of weekly tutoring – confidence often translates into better preparation and performance, even when starting a bit behind. While we can’t guarantee a specific grade, the extra practice and personalized feedback can close gaps quickly.

If you want the most intensive support before the final, the **Plus** plan (8 sessions / month) gives two sessions each week, giving you more touch‑points in the six‑week window.  

When you’re ready, you can enroll at **brightwaterlearning.example/enroll**. I’m happy to answer any quick follow‑up!

Okay, but that 71% figure is about feeling more confident, not about passing. My kid is failing and their teacher says the real problem is 8th-grade gaps like fractions and solving equations. Does the tutor actually go back and fix those, or only work on the current unit? And what exactly happens to my money if it doesn't help, can I cancel after the first month and get a refund?

Great questions! Our tutors specialize in **Algebra II** and will work on the exact unit your child is studying and the upcoming test material. They can address specific missing skills (e.g., fractions or basic equation solving) **only when those gaps show up in the current Algebra II work**—they don’t provide a full 8th‑grade review curriculum.

**Money‑back & cancellation:**  
- If you request a refund within **7 days of signup** and only ≤ 1 session has been used, you’ll get a **full refund of the first month**.  
- After that, you can **cancel anytime** from your account page; the plan will simply stop renewing after the current paid month—no refund for the remaining days, but no cancellation fee.

If you’d like to give it a try, you can enroll at **brightwaterlearning.example/enroll**. Let me know if you need anything else!

Okay, so it only fixes 8th-grade gaps if they happen to come up in the Algebra II work, and there's no real review. That's the part I was hoping for, since the teacher says the fractions and equation solving are the real problem. And the refund only works in the first 7 days with one session or less used, otherwise I just lose the rest of the month. I work evenings and I can't keep paying for something that isn't clearly fixing this, so I need to think it over and talk to my kid before I decide anything.
